notes: Minnesota requires sufficient unpaid meal time for 8+ consecutive hours and an adequate paid rest period within each 4 consecutive hours (DOL tables); durations not specified, so not encoded.
Minneapolis and St. Paul set higher local minimum wages; no city files yet.
No state daily overtime listed in the DOL table.
Drafted from US DOL WHD state tables (confidence=medium) on 2026-11-06; upgrade to primary sources pending.
minimum_wage.effective is the DOL table date (2026-11-05), not the statutory effective date.

Minors (Minn. Stat. § 181A.04): the under-16 limits are the same in school and non-school weeks (identical school_week true/false rules); federal 3 h / 18 h / 7 p.m. school-week limits (federal.json) also apply to FLSA-covered employers.
Minors: the 16-17 high-school 11 p.m. / 5 a.m. limit applies only around school days; enforced every day of a school week (stricter). No other MN hour limits for 16-17.

No tip credit: 'No employer may directly or indirectly credit, apply, or utilize gratuities towards payment of the minimum wage set by this section or federal law' (Minn. Stat. § 177.24 subd. 2, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/177.24). No tipped_minimum_wage rule.
